parameters.name: ChannelName
parameters.description: The unique name for the replication channel.

parameters.name: MasterHost
parameters.description: The IP address or domain name of the master database.

parameters.name: MasterPassword
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded password for the replication user on the master database.

parameters.name: MasterPort
parameters.description: The port number of the master database. Default: 3306.

parameters.name: MasterUser
parameters.description: The username for the replication account on the master database. Specify this parameter only to update the username.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: The operation to perform on the replication channel. Valid values: Start, Stop, Restart, and Rebuild.
